Staffer.ai | Remote | Senior Clojure(Script) developer| EU, or Hybrid - Lisbon or Oslo

https://careers.staffer.ai/jobs/5751618-senior-clojure-scrip...

Staffer.ai builds an AI-driven ATS in Clojure + PostgreSQL. Looking for a senior engineer strong in backend with solid frontend understanding (ClojureScript).

You will shape architecture, integrate AI features, and own full-stack delivery. Remote, B2B, stock options, experienced Clojure team.
